title: Blogsify
description: A full-stack blogging platform built with React for a dynamic frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. title: Netflix Clone
description: A full-stack app mimicking Netflix, built with React for a dynamic, responsive UI and Node.js with Express for the backend API. title: IMDB
description: This is a full-stack web application inspired by IMDb, designed to manage and display movie information. Features include dynamic routing, state management (e.g., with Redux or Context API), and a sleek design using modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS.
